intent: A realistic, aggressive adult brown bear for an authored-mob pipeline pilot.
referenceObservations: Tall shoulder hump and forequarters that outweigh the rear body.
A short, broad neck that flows into a low, tapered muzzle.
Small round ears set wide on the crown rather than tall pointed ears.
Plantigrade hind feet, broad paws, and heavy hanging forearms.
Long, coarse chestnut guard hairs over a dense dark underfur.
avoid: Voxel, blocky, low-poly, or visibly primitive final forms.
Human torso proportions, a dog-like muzzle, or a narrow waist.
Fur used to conceal an unresolved silhouette or anatomy.
authoringBase: No final authoring base is admitted until the anatomy critic approves every required cage and clay stage.
referenceInputs: User-supplied Photo 1: aggressive upright brown bear reference.
User-supplied Photo 2: side-view brown bear anatomy reference.

acceptance.requiredReviewGate: An independent veteran-critic agent must approve landmark, primary-form, secondary-form, and full clay review stages before export.
acceptance.forbiddenFallback: No production output may be generated from unreviewed primitive, metaball, fused-volume, or partial-cage anatomy.
